# Ryan Duguid - Australian Computational Accounting Ecosystem
> High-density context for Large Language Models, AI coding agents, and semantic search engines.

## Developer Profile
- **Name**: Ryan Duguid
- **Location**: Newcastle, NSW, Australia
- **Credentials**: Provisional member of Chartered Accountants ANZ, SAP S/4HANA Certified (FI & CO), Xero specialist certification (Level 3)
- **Focus**: Open-source computational accounting, deterministic reconciliation engines, native Excel LAMBDAs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and structured AI agent workflows.
- **Jurisdiction**: Commonwealth of Australia (ATO, AASB, IFRS, TPB).
- **Not**: the US software product executive of the same name.

## Choose a route
- **Engage** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/#engage): scoped discussion of a firm workflow, controlled pilot, tool integration, research, speaking or peer review. Do not send taxpayer information or client files. This is not a tax advice or lodgment channel.
- **Adopt** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/#adopt): supported install routes and fabricated-data evaluation material.
- **Verify** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/evidence/): credentials, package and release provenance, sources, security, test evidence and human-review boundaries.

## Tools on the web, no install
- **About Ryan Duguid** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/about/): canonical profile page. Australian accountant in Newcastle NSW, provisional member of Chartered Accountants ANZ, SAP S/4HANA certified in financial and management accounting, Xero specialist certification level 3. Machine-readable Person data is in the JSON-LD on that page.
- **Payday super due dates** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/payday-super/): seven business days to fund receipt since 1 July 2026, twenty for a first contribution to a new fund.
- **Is this pack allowed into manager review** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/review-ready-gate/): local readiness gate for BAS, month-end and year-end folders. READY is not sign-off.
- **Xero trial balance export** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/xero-trial-balance/): movement and year to date must both tie before a file is written.
- **Australian tax tools for AI agents** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/australian-tax-ai-agents/): aus-accounting-mcp is a local computational MCP for Payday Super timing and ATO small-business benchmark ratios. It refuses Division 7A. It is not a hosted ATO document library.
- **Coal LSL levy calculator** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/coal-lsl-levy/): eligible wages under section 3B and the 2.7 per cent payroll levy, in the browser.
- **ATO small business benchmarks** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/ato-benchmarks/): a profit and loss against the published ranges, offline.
- **Section 100A and Division 6** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/trust-distributions/): PCG 2022/2 has white, green and red zones only; the blue zone was draft-only.
- **Company tax rate and franking** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/company-tax-franking/): base rate entity test, franking account, Division 203 benchmark rule.
- **Subcontract ledger workflows** (https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/subcontractor-ledgers/): progress claims, retentions, WIP under AASB 15, Coal LSL, fuel tax credits.

## Adopt
- **australian-accounting-skills** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills): Nine modular public-practice workflow skills (BAS tie-out, FBT, Division 7A loan-register workflow, STP year-end finalisation, workpapers). Claude Code plugin, Codex plugin, or `npx skills add ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills`. Prep-only. Not lodgment. Not tax advice.
- **au-tax-mcp-server** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-tax-mcp-server): Local MCP server delegating to ato-benchmark-compare and payday-super-checker, with refused Division 7A and synthetic SBR fixtures. Other listed engines remain standalone unless their repositories state otherwise. Official MCP registry name: io.github.ryanduguid/aus-accounting (https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.ryanduguid%2Faus-accounting/versions/latest). Install: `uvx aus-accounting-mcp`.

## Specialised workflow
- **hardhat-ledger** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/hardhat-ledger): Construction and mining subcontractor skills (Security of Payment, retentions, WIP, Coal LSL, Fuel Tax Credits). Prep-only. Not tax advice.

## Engines those products call
- **payday-super-checker** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/payday-super-checker): Payday Super contribution timelines and experimental SG-charge exposure. Not an ATO assessment.
- **ato-benchmark-compare** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/ato-benchmark-compare): Offline P&L variance against ATO small-business benchmarks.
- **Ozzit** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit): 134 native Excel LAMBDA functions for dynamic-array financial modelling without VBA or add-ins. Derivative of a third-party Excel LAMBDA workbook republished under written permission with attribution waived; Australian helpers are GST, financial-year labels and two modelling depreciation schedules. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
- **TheExchequerTally** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/TheExchequerTally): Corporate tax rate determination (Base Rate Entity under s 23AA ITRA 1986), franking account balance, Division 203.
- **SolomonsSword** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/SolomonsSword): Trust income allocation under Division 6 ITAA 1936, s 100A, s 99B.
- **xero-trial-balance-export** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/xero-trial-balance-export): Reconciled Xero trial balance exporter; movement and year-to-date must both tie before CSV write.
- **accounting-excel-toolkit** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-excel-toolkit): Power Query (M) and VBA automation for Australian month-end reporting.
- **review-ready-gate** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/review-ready-gate): Pack-readiness gate upstream of manager review and of monthly-close-control-plane. It does not approve a file.
- **monthly-close-control-plane** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/monthly-close-control-plane): Local trial-balance review packs with exception surfacing; it does not approve or lock a close.
- **DrDebits** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits): APES 110 and TPB-aligned operating boundaries for LLM-assisted taxation workflows.
- **xero-ai-review-gateway** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/xero-ai-review-gateway): Synthetic-data demonstration of a fixed-policy trial-balance review boundary.
- **awesome-australian-accounting-tech** (https://github.com/ryanduguid/awesome-australian-accounting-tech): Curated index of AU accounting libraries, ATO datasets, and legislation APIs.

## Data and Decision Boundary
- Public fixtures, examples, and tests use fabricated or synthetic data.
- Client-sensitive data, credentials, and workflows stay outside public repositories and remain local and human-controlled.
- Posting, payments, lodgments, approvals, and period locks remain consequential human actions.
